results.title: Label Traxx new features | Amtech at Loupe Americas 2026
results.description: In this interview, recorded at Loupe Americas 2026 in Chicago, Grant Emison, head of label products at Amtech Software, explains three new developments for Label Traxx, the company's software for label converters. The track and trace module treats rolls taken off a press as serialized inventory, shows ticket progress and traces a quality problem from a finished roll back to its source and forward to affected customers. Visual analytics, already used by hundreds of Amtech corrugated customers, brings label converters editable dashboards and scheduled reports.
